name: New Jersey
description: Follow New Jersey, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: New Jersey's Mikie Sherrill enters national political fray with first set of midterm endorsements, aimed at veterans
changes.summary: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill is taking her first major step onto the national stage, endorsing 13 Democrats - as the moderate signals she may jump into the debate over her party's future.

changes.title: Voter-Registration Error Could Cost Immigrants a Shot at a Green Card
changes.summary: New Jersey improperly added as many as 6,600 noncitizens to its voter rolls. Those people could now be forced out of the country.

changes.title: Long-term study suggests landfill methane emissions are far higher than estimates
changes.summary: Methane is an especially potent greenhouse gas, causing much more warming than carbon dioxide on a unit-for-unit basis—and a new, uniquely long-term study of emissions at a New Jersey landfill suggests that estimates of methane pollution in the U.S. and elsewhere may be dramatically off. changes.title: Nurse-led initiative reduces unplanned extubations
changes.summary: A nurse-led initiative at a New Jersey hospital reversed an upward trend of unplanned extubation rates in its medical intensive care unit (MICU) and maintained the improvement for five years, according to an article published in Critical Care Nurse (CCN).

changes.title: Body of missing girl found in New Jersey's Passaic River after 2-day search, mayor says
changes.summary: The body of a missing girl was found in the Passaic River in New Jersey after a two-day search, officials said.

changes.title: 'Software Error' Led Hundreds of Noncitizens to Vote in NJ
changes.summary: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill says a DMV software error led to more than 6,000 noncitizens being registered to vote when they signed up for driver’s licenses or ID cards. changes.title: Error Led to 400 Noncitizens Voting in New Jersey, Governor Says
changes.summary: A 2023 software glitch at the state’s Motor Vehicle Commission led to roughly 6,600 noncitizens being registered to vote during the Murphy administration, Gov. Mikie Sherrill announced.

changes.title: 6,600 noncitizens registered to vote by New Jersey motor vehicle system error, Gov. Sherill says
changes.summary: The Democratic governor, who took office this year, blamed a Motor Vehicle Commission system software error but said a preliminary analysis showed that fewer than 400 of the people registered that way went on to cast ballots.
